b'# tinydl

A lightweight command-line downloader.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [options]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Help Text |
|--------|-----------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Description

`tinydl` downloads the content at the given URL and writes it to a file or stdout. By default it prints the number of bytes downloaded to stderr. Use `--quiet` to suppress that output. Use `--output` to write the downloaded data to a file instead of stdout.'
